capabilities: Present the current note as slides in a tab, side pane, or separate window
Split a plain note into slides at headings and horizontal rules
Author decks with Marp syntax and directives via front matter
Render Obsidian content (code, math, callouts, embeds, footnotes) inside slides
Navigate presentations with keyboard, full screen, progress bar, and projector window
disambiguation: Not a search or screen-highlighting tool despite the name; it presents notes as slides.
extras: Desktop app only (needs Obsidian 1.5.7+), does not run on mobile; exporting to HTML/PDF and a presenter view are not available yet; makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to present the note you are reading as slides without maintaining a separate deck file.

relations.evidence: Spotlight Slides is built on Marp Core and Marpit, by the Marp team, under the MIT license.

summary: Slide presenter that turns any note into 16:9 slides inside Obsidian, splitting it automatically or following Marp syntax, with live preview and projector window.
